description.value: Hillview Guest Rooms is a small, family-run motel on the eastern edge of Vanderhoof along the Yellowhead Highway (Hwy 16), a major transcontinental cycling route. The property has operated for over a decade and earned a 2024/25 Travel & Hospitality Award, positioning itself as the best-value lodging in town. Rooms include microwaves, refrigerators, and optional kitchenettes, and select units are pet-friendly — practical features for self-sufficient touring cyclists on a long-haul trip.

address.value: 1533 Highway 16 East, Vanderhoof, BC, Canada V0J 3A0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at thehillview.ca is active with April 2026 updates, confirming this is a real, operating property in Vanderhoof, BC.
